title: [mod-archiver] E2E test Nexus Mods source
description:
mod-archiver Nexus source (internal/source/nexus.go) is implemented but never tested against the live API. Need NEXUS_API_KEY (personal key, nexusmods.com my account api access).

Test: NEXUS_API_KEY=... ./bin/mod-archiver -v nexus:skyrim:3863
Verify: metadata parse, files.json listing, download_link.json resolution, CDN download + resume, X-RL rate headers.
Also test free-account path: -nxm-key/-nxm-expires from an nxm:// link.

title: [mod-archiver] E2E test mod.io source
description:
mod-archiver mod.io source (internal/source/modio.go) is implemented from docs but never tested against the live API. Need MODIO_API_KEY (free, mod.io/me/access).

Test: MODIO_API_KEY=... ./bin/mod-archiver -v modio:drg:<mod-slug>
Verify: name_id slug resolution, games endpoint, modfiles pagination, filehash md5 verification, binary_url expiry re-resolution.
